meta.cv: outer: 5 x StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True), random_state = 42 + repeat, same splits as baselines.json; inner: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5) on the outer training fold only
meta.per_training_fold: in-fold redundancy pruning -> grid search on inner ROC-AUC -> best model (or soft vote of top 3 by inner ROC-AUC) -> Platt calibration on inner out-of-fold probabilities -> threshold = highest calibrated cut-off with inner OOF sensitivity >= 0.8 -> refit on the whole training fold
meta.final_model_choice: soft_vote_top3 was fixed before seeing outer results (brief: soft-voting ensemble of the best syllabus models); it is not picked as the best outer score
meta.headline: fold_mean: mean over 25 outer folds, 95% Nadeau-Bengio corrected t-interval; delta = paired per-fold after - before, same correction
